verdict.rationale: Tailscale describes itself as a mesh overlay network connecting devices across clouds and on-prem, and users report SSH'ing straight into their own boxes without public exposure. However, it is itself a VPN, which conflicts with the story's 'without a VPN' framing. A hands-on report also says its NAT traversal doesn't always work and traffic falls back to DERP relay servers, limiting speed. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of direct peer-to-peer connections, guaranteed relay-free paths, and operation without a VPN layer.
